Alisa Weilerstein (cello), Jason Yoder (marimba) Documented

Commons names Weilerstein and Yoder; the instrument comes from Weilerstein’s interview and the White House page.

Work version
Cello and marimba Documented

Weilerstein calls Yoder “a marimba player”; the White House describes him as a sixteen-year-old percussionist. Saint-⁠Saëns wrote the movement for cello and two pianos; the performing edition is not established.
